689:t_028:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then it comes down to $$アサキム$$, you lot, and me... to see who collects the twelve Spheres.」

689:t_028:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Whoever assembles them is the one who can overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

689:t_028:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you came here to declare war, huh?」

689:t_028:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Precisely. Know that the next time we meet will be the time we settle this.」

689:t_029:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「As expected of a man who styled himself emperor and general. He knows what courtesy is.」

689:t_029:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「That guy... He knows we've achieved $$真化融合$$, and he's still going to challenge us?」

689:t_029:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Same as $$アサキム$$. I'd bet he's become able to use the power of four Spheres too.」

689:t_029:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think $$アサキム$$ has come to this $$カオス・コスモス$$ too.」

689:t_029:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Us, the $$御使い$$s, $$アサキム$$ and $$ヴィルダーク$$... And we're all going to crush each other?」

689:t_029:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「They seem to think we're the easiest opponent for them to handle.」

689:t_029:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So what you mean is, they'll be coming after us...」

689:t_029:7.en:
$$桂$$
「It's nothing new, but being popular is tough.」

689:t_029:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Now that what we have to do is clear, all we can do is keep moving forward, one step at a time.」

689:t_029:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「...But we can't afford to take it that slowly.」

689:t_029:10.en:
$n
「So the limit of the $$スヴェル$$ came sooner than expected...」

689:t_029:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When we did $$真化融合$$, I could feel the will of the people of Earth through the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and the Spheres.」

689:t_029:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「That was possible only because of the feelings of the people of Earth, who entrusted everything to us.」

689:t_029:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And because of that... a huge amount of Earth's $$次元力$$ was used...」

689:t_029:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「Exactly. By my calculations, activating it used up a third of the $$次元力$$ Earth had been storing, all at once.」

689:t_029:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the last day of Earth came ten days sooner...」

689:t_029:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then we just have to hurry.」

689:t_029:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... With this power, we'll defeat the $$御使い$$s for sure.」

689:t_029:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have an idea for how we can find out where they are.」

689:t_029:19.en:
$$エスター$$
「As expected of the Chief! You're so reliable!」

689:t_029:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Now that we've gained new power and what we have to do is clear, there's something we need to confirm.」

689:t_029:21.en:
$$シャア$$
「You'll tell us, $$ＡＧ$$... what you really are.」

689:t_030:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「We can't hold the line any longer!」

689:t_031:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「No good... The $$ソーラリアン$$ is... going down...」

689:t_033:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$セツコ・オハラ$$, arrived at the point!」

689:t_033:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Stand by there until we're ready on our end!」

689:t_033:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Leave the enemies around here to us! We'll protect $$セツコ$$!」

689:t_033:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you. I'm counting on you.」

689:t_034:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ビーター・サービス$$, arriving right now!」

689:t_034:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Good work! Hold out there for a little while!」

689:t_034:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Got it! We're counting on you to take care of the enemies around us!」

689:t_034:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Leave it to me! I'll swat down every fly that swarms us!」

689:t_035:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$, mission complete.」

689:t_035:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't let your guard down! Stand by there until we're ready on our end!」

689:t_035:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「OK! I'm counting on you to handle any enemies coming our way!」

689:t_035:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That job is gonna cost you!」

689:t_035:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「One lunch on you for every enemy we shoot down!」

689:t_035:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If sugar water's good enough, I'll treat you.」

689:t_036:0.en:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$, arrived at the point!」

689:t_036:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「We're almost ready on our end! Hang in there until then!」

689:t_036:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry, $n. We'll take care of the trash around here.」

689:t_036:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's right, Miss $$スズネ$$! Just take it easy there!」

689:t_036:5.en:
$n
「Sorry about this. I'll be relying on you for a little while.」

689:t_037:2.en:
$$レド$$
「So this is $$真化融合$$... Power where man and machine become completely one...」

689:t_037:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Analysis impossible. However, this is a fact.」

689:t_037:4.en:
$n
「We can do it! With this power...!」

689:t_039:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Please tell me, $$マキ#pilot$$. Did you approach $n on $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders?」

689:t_039:2.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「...I don't know... Before I knew it, I was hearing Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s voice and trying to worm my way into $n's heart.」

689:t_039:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And was it the same when you fell for $n?」

689:t_039:6.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Whether those feelings were my own, or Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s will...」

689:t_040:1.en:
$n
「I'm sorry, $$マキ#pilot$$... Because of me... $$マキ#pilot$$'s destiny is...」

689:t_040:2.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「No! I'm... a person chosen by Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

689:t_040:3.en:
$n
「...Please go on living in some world... Forget about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... and about me...」

689:t_040:4.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「N-no! I belong at Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s side...!」

689:t_042:0.en:
$n
「...I'll fight, Miss $$スズネ$$. To defeat the $$御使い$$s... to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

689:t_042:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That your fight is my fight too.」
